Greetings Mr. Epstein, I am Craig Knowles, It's been a while since our paths
have crossed. I hope all is well with you and yours. I don't know if you
remember me, but I was the PBSO Sergeant on duty when you were
released years ago. I wanted take this opportunity to introduce you to Gun
Club Elite Football Club Inc. I attached a flyer to give you an idea of what we
are doing. These guys started out as a flag football team just participating in
select tournaments throughout the state of Florida. As stated in flyer, all are
PBSO employees. When taking them over I wanted to go into a different
direction that involved football and charity contributions. I have incorporated
the Club, I have an tax exemption that allows us to be a Non Profit Entity.
We sacrifice our time, finances to make it work. We collect dues monthly for
our miscellaneous items like Gatorade, water, etc.. for us to function as a
team. We are in need of sponsorship or donation to allow us to fulfill our
vision to help others and to allow us to reach goals that we have set, some
short term and some long term. I was hoping you could help out in one of
those capacities, either as an sponsor or donator, especially since it's all tax
deductible. I don't know many people personally that I feel comfortable
enough to ask, but I have to step out of my comfort zone to help others and
to see this come to fruition. Nothing beats a failure but a try. I have some
support from a couple of upper management, but its not financial where we
really need it to perform community service and give to those who are less
fortunate or going through trying times. I truly hope you can help us out in
any way possible. Thank you very much in advance for your much
anticipated act of kindness. God Bless
Respectfully and Sincerely, Craig Knowles
Go Elite!!!!

EFTA01196313

 We are sponsoring a fund raiser for Relay For Life in October by selling
candy apples, with all proceeds going for Cancer Research. This is one a the
many things we are getting involved in to help off the field. It's better to give
than to receive.
